audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The written augmentation graph and its complexity are incorrect; The printed update pseudocode violates its excess invariant; The crossing estimate has the wrong scale factor.
limitations: 0346-F1 — Counterevidence: Claims E.1-E.2 provide the standard repair idea. Released C++ lines 313-350 uses directed residual transitions and exposed destinations, including direct pairing. Independent corrected-network checks pass on 100 enumerated small instances.

0346-F2 — Counterevidence: Changing to pre-update eta avoids the first branch failure but not the union error. The invariant prose and code _modify_recursive support a corrected endpoint-based procedure.
0346-F3 — Counterevidence: Equation5 uses the corrected multiplication. Corrected constants preserve expected O(1/epsilon) route.
0346-F4 — Counterevidence: Historical experiments may have used another revision or timer. Matching costs are maintained using actual distances.

Counterevidence: Correct directed forward/reverse residual graph repairs standard extension; C++313-350 uses such transitions and exposed endpoints. p=n^(epsilon/10) gives exponent slack, so headline existence theorem is not disproved.
Counterevidence: C++511-552 uses endpoint deltas/removals and intended prose states correct invariant; no same implementation failure established.

Counterevidence: Equation5 uses the correct multiplication; derived same-bound inequality survives under original fixed-instance assumptions. A small-lambda example is not needed to claim the displayed Big-O statement false under all grid restrictions.
Counterevidence: Historical benchmark may use another revision. Actual point-distance costs are maintained separately.

Limits: No author code or benchmark executed, no universal release correctness or adaptive guarantee. Initial complete coverage and original figure inspections reused without claiming repeated full audit.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
